body_cn: 每一次技术浪潮，都始于共识之外。
总有少数人，在路径清晰之前，看见真正重要的可能。
星连相信这些早期判断，也用长期资本支持它们成为现实。
body_en: Every technology wave begins outside consensus.
A rare few see what matters before the path becomes obvious.
LinkX backs these early convictions with long-term capital, helping them become real.

title_cn: 在行业格局成形之前发现企业。
description_cn: 星连资本成立于 2021 年，专注人工智能与下一代智能技术的早期投资。在这一轮智能浪潮成为市场共识之前，我们就已对 AI 的长期潜力形成坚定判断，并持续投入研究与资本。我们重点支持研究型创业者（researcher-founders），相信深厚的科研积累与独到的技术洞察，能够成为独特产品和优秀公司的起点。
我们的投资覆盖六个方向：基础模型与学习范式、芯片、AI 基础设施、AI 原生应用、具身智能、科学智能。
我们在研究与创业的早期阶段就与团队建立联系，通过长期资本、孵化支持和产业资源，帮助研究成果转化为产品、走向市场。我们寻找能够拓展智能边界、重塑产业格局的下一代公司。
description_en: Founded in 2021, LinkX Capital invests early in AI and the technologies shaping the next generation of intelligence. We built conviction in AI's long-term potential before the current wave gained broad market recognition, and have backed it with sustained research and investment. We support researcher-founders, believing that deep research expertise and distinctive technical insight can lay the foundations for differentiated products and exceptional companies.
Our investments span six areas: Foundation Models & Learning, Chips, AI Infrastructure, AI-Native Applications, Embodied AI, and AI for Science.

We work with teams from the early stages of research and company formation, combining long-term capital, incubation support and industry connections to help turn research into products and bring them to market. We look for the next generation of companies that expand the frontiers of intelligence and reshape industries.

intro_cn: 星连团队来自科技投资、产品、工程与平台战略的一线。不同的职业路径，让我们能够同时理解技术本身、产品形成的过程，以及一家年轻公司成长所需要的资本与资源。
我们相信，早期投资的关键，是在答案尚未清晰时，判断什么值得长期相信。
intro_en: The LinkX team brings together experience across venture investing, product, engineering and platform strategy.

Those different paths shape how we evaluate technology, understand how products take form, and support young companies as they grow. Early-stage investing requires judgment about what is worth believing in before the answers are obvious.

intro_cn: 技术变化得越快，判断越需要被反复验证。
星连的内部研究团队持续跟踪模型能力、产品形态与真实使用的变化，通过研究、产品测试和与一线团队交流，理解哪些变化只是短暂噪音，哪些可能真正改变行业。
这里记录我们的研究、观察与实践。
intro_en: The faster technology moves, the more conviction needs to be tested.
LinkX's in-house research team follows changes in model capability, product behavior and real-world adoption through research, hands-on testing and direct conversations with teams in the field.
This is where we share what we are learning, questioning and watching closely.

description_cn: **LinkX Fellowship Programme** 是星连资本面向全球青年科学家、研究型创业者、技术领袖与前沿探索者发起的 Fellowship Network。
我们希望更早遇见那些独立提问、持续验证，并努力让研究从论文走向现实的人。
Fellow 将进入由研究者、创业者与产业伙伴组成的长期网络，参与闭门研讨，并获得算力、模型及产业资源支持。Fellow 也可以与星连共同发现和支持优秀的早期项目，让对技术、趋势与人才的前沿认知转化为真实的资本判断，并**分享由优秀判断所创造的长期价值**。
对于进入创业阶段的 Fellow，星连将根据项目进展提供孵化、产业资源及早期投资支持。
Fellowship 无需全职参与。我们也鼓励 Fellow 发现并推荐更年轻、更早期的 **Young Pioneer**；入选者将获得星连提供的**奖学金及研究资源支持**，帮助他们更自由地探索真正重要的问题。
**让远见彼此辉映，让重要的探索不再孤立发生。**
description_en: **LinkX Constellation Fellowship** is a global fellowship for young scientists, researcher-founders, technology leaders, and those with a distinctive ability to recognize important ideas and exceptional talent early.
We look for people who ask original questions about the future of intelligence, pursue answers with persistence, and push research beyond papers into the real world.

Fellows join a close network of researchers, founders, and industry partners, with access to private discussions, compute, model resources, and broader ecosystem support. They can also work with LinkX to identify and support promising early-stage ventures, turning frontier insight into real investment decisions and **sharing in the long-term value created by exceptional judgment**.
For Fellows exploring entrepreneurship, LinkX can provide incubation support, strategic resources, and early-stage investment as their work develops.

The Fellowship does not require full-time participation. Fellows are also encouraged to identify and recommend emerging talent for the **Young Pioneer** track. Selected Young Pioneers will receive **scholarship funding and research support** from LinkX, giving them greater freedom to pursue ambitious and important questions.
**Important ideas should not have to grow alone.**

sectors.description_cn: 关注推动模型能力跃迁的架构与学习方法，包括推理、多模态、世界模型、持续学习与自进化。
sectors.description_en: We explore architectures and learning methods that expand model capability, including reasoning, multimodality, world models, continual learning and self-improvement.

sectors.description_cn: 关注支撑 AI 训练、推理与端侧智能的芯片及关键技术，包括计算架构、存储与互连、先进封装和软硬件协同。
sectors.description_en: We focus on chips and enabling technologies for AI training, inference and on-device intelligence, including compute architectures, memory and interconnects, advanced packaging, and hardware-software co-design.

sectors.description_cn: 覆盖算力网络、模型训练与推理系统、数据平台和安全，让 AI 更高效、更可靠地进入实际使用。
sectors.description_en: Compute networks, training and inference systems, data platforms and security make AI more efficient, reliable and usable at scale.

sectors.description_cn: 支持围绕真实需求与工作流程设计的 AI 原生产品，包括能够理解任务、调用工具并从反馈中改进的智能体，以及面向企业与个人的新应用。
sectors.description_en: We back AI-native products built around real user needs and workflows, from agents that understand tasks, use tools and improve through feedback to new applications for businesses and consumers.

sectors.description_cn: 关注机器人、具身模型、感知与控制系统，以及智能终端，让 AI 在物理环境中感知、决策和行动。
sectors.description_en: We explore robotics, embodied models, perception and control systems, and intelligent devices that enable AI to sense, decide and act in the physical world.

sectors.description_cn: 以 AI 推进生命科学、药物研发、材料与能源研究，连接计算设计、实验验证与科学发现，探索新的科研方法与工具。
sectors.description_en: We support AI for biology, drug discovery, materials and energy research, connecting computational design with experimental validation to develop new methods and tools for scientific discovery.

team.summary_cn: 从产品一线看技术，也从投资视角看团队。
team.summary_en: A product-builder's eye for technology and founders.
team.bio_cn:
张鸣晨在清华大学自动化系完成本科与硕士学业。他曾就职于 Google 和腾讯，并担任腾讯产品总监；进入投资领域后，先后任职于策源创投与红点创投，曾任红点创投合伙人。

他长期活跃于清华校友圈，与科研人员、技术人才和创业者保持密切交流。产品、平台与投资的经历，让他能够从技术实现、用户需求和企业成长三个层面理解早期机会。他尤其关注研究型创业者如何将原创成果转化为产品，并建立有长期竞争力的公司。
team.bio_en:
Alex Zhang holds bachelor's and master's degrees in Automation from Tsinghua University. His early career included Google and a Product Director role at Tencent. He went on to work at Ceyuan Ventures before joining Redpoint Ventures, where he was a Partner.

Active in the Tsinghua alumni community, Alex maintains close ties with researchers, technical talent and founders. His experience across product, platforms and venture investing shapes how he assesses early opportunities, from technical execution and user needs to company growth. He is particularly interested in how researcher-founders turn original work into products and build companies with lasting competitive strengths.

team.summary_cn: 资深科技投资人，兼具工程与大型平台经验。
team.summary_en: An experienced technology investor with engineering and platform fluency.
team.bio_cn: 王璞曾任策源创投投资总监、Hanfor Capital 董事总经理，长期深耕科技投资。此前他在腾讯担任总监，具备大型科技平台的管理经验，拥有通信工程背景及南洋理工大学 MBA 学位。他将工程理解与商业判断结合，评估早期项目的技术壁垒、产品路径与市场潜力。从投资到平台管理的经历，使他能够理解企业在不同成长阶段的关键选择与资本需求。
team.bio_en: Elliott Wang served as Investment Director at Ceyuan Ventures and Managing Director at Hanfor Capital, building extensive experience in technology investing. He was previously a Director at Tencent and combines a background in telecommunications engineering with an MBA from Nanyang Technological University. He brings technical and commercial depth to assessing a venture's defensibility, product direction and market potential. His experience across investing and platform management informs how he evaluates strategic choices and capital needs as companies grow.

team.summary_cn: 在研究突破与创业实践之间搭桥。
team.summary_en: A bridge between scientific discovery and company creation.
team.bio_cn: 李文珏曾任中科创星及北京智源人工智能研究院投资总监，具备科技投资与 AI 科研机构的双重经历。她长期与科研团队和技术创业者交流，熟悉原创成果从实验室走向创业实践的关键环节。她从技术原创性、创始团队与应用场景出发，判断研究成果进入产业的潜力。她尤其关注研究型创业者，重点评估技术优势如何形成产品，以及支撑公司长期成长的商业路径。
team.bio_en: Wenjue Li served as Investment Director at Casstar and the Beijing Academy of Artificial Intelligence, bringing experience across technology investing and AI research institutions. Her close work with researchers and technical founders gives her insight into the transition from original research to company creation. She evaluates technical originality, founding teams and use cases to assess a discovery's commercial potential. With a particular focus on researcher-founders, she examines how technical advantages become products and support a company's long-term growth.

team.summary_cn: 把战略判断带到实际增长与全球市场。
team.summary_en: Connecting strategy with scale and global growth.
team.bio_cn: 王晨的职业经历横跨美团、快手与 SHAREit，涵盖战略、投资和全球化业务。他曾在美团从事战略与投资，负责快手投资发展工作，并担任 SHAREit 集团首席战略官。大型互联网平台与全球化业务的经历，使他熟悉企业从产品验证到规模增长所面临的关键选择。他尤其关注产品、资本与市场拓展如何协同，评估技术企业的增长路径与国际竞争力。
team.bio_en: Leo Wang's career spans Meituan, Kuaishou and SHAREit, with experience across strategy, investment and global business. He worked in strategy and investment at Meituan, led investment development at Kuaishou and served as Chief Strategy Officer of SHAREit Group. These roles give him a practical understanding of the decisions companies face as they move from product validation to scale. He assesses how product strategy, capital and market expansion work together to build growth and international competitiveness.

team.summary_cn: 以严谨的投资判断，支持早期科技项目成长。
team.summary_en: A rigorous early-stage investor with hands-on incubation experience.
team.bio_cn: 鲁亦纯曾在红点中国与红杉中国从事早期科技投资，具备研究、投资与项目孵化经验。她在伦敦大学学院完成数学与经济学本硕学业，将扎实的定量训练融入技术与商业判断。她以严谨的研究支持投资决策，并曾成功帮助早期项目完成孵化。她关注技术潜力、产品需求与团队执行力之间的关系，判断早期创新如何成长为具有持续竞争力的企业。
team.bio_en: Chris Lu worked on early-stage technology investments at Redpoint China and Sequoia China, with experience across research, investing and incubation. She holds bachelor's and master's degrees in Mathematics and Economics from University College London, bringing quantitative discipline to technical and commercial analysis. Her research-led investment approach has helped incubate early-stage companies. She assesses the relationship between technical potential, product demand and team execution to understand how early innovation can become a durable, competitive business.

team.summary_cn: 兼具工程背景与产业经验的科技投资人。
team.summary_en: A technology investor with an engineering background and industry experience.
team.bio_cn: 关蕾兼具工程、产品与科技投资背景，教育经历涵盖电气工程及可再生能源。她曾在华锐风电与 ABB 从事产品相关工作，在新能源产业与全球工业企业积累了技术和产品经验。此后她加入红点创投中国基金，将产业一线的理解带入早期投资判断。她从技术实现、应用需求与商业化路径出发评估创业机会，尤其关注创新能否在真实场景中形成可靠产品并持续创造价值。
team.bio_en: Emily Guan brings experience across engineering, product development and technology investing, with an academic background in electrical engineering and renewable energy. Product roles at Huarui Wind Power and ABB gave her direct exposure to renewable energy and global industrial businesses. She later joined Redpoint Ventures China Fund, bringing that industry perspective to early-stage investing.
